title: mocon links
description: extensions/links.md. An optional top-level array on execution and crossing records, always carried by the newer record and pointing back at the older one. Core performs no referential check on it, exactly as it performs none on crossing.execution_id.

rel.description: The relation this record has to the named one: retry_of, replay_of, forked_from, continues in this version. The shape, not the membership, is validated here — the set grows by minor version and a consumer drops an entry whose rel it does not know rather than rejecting the stream.

kind.description: The kind of the record named. Required because ids are unique only within (host, kind) (core.md section 6). Unlike rel this is a core closed set and does not grow.

counts.description: additive or duplicate: whether this record's values are additional to the named record's or repeat them. Required on every entry, because there is no safe default and the host always knows which its case is. Shape-validated, like rel.

host.description: The named record's host string. Absent means this line's own host. A value naming another host is the carrying host's claim about a record it does not own; it creates none of the cross-host join core.md section 4 rule 6 refuses.

execution_id.description: Meaningful only under kind crossing, where an exporter needs it to derive the named crossing's trace id. On a crossing line, absent means this line's own execution_id.
